name: embedded-browser
description: Opens a browser inside a VS Code webview panel with an allowlist, a configurable search engine and extension-side navigation history.
author: Canelon

canelonBrowser.allowlist.markdownDescription: Patterns of URLs the browser is allowed to load. Only `http:` and `https:` are supported. Patterns may use `*` as a host wildcard (`*.internal.company.com`), an exact port (`localhost:3000`), a port wildcard (`localhost:*`) and a path prefix (`https://docs.python.org/*`). A pattern without a scheme matches both `http` and `https`. Only used when `#canelonBrowser.securityPolicy#` is `strict`.

enumDescriptions: Block every URL that is not covered by `canelonBrowser.allowlist`.
canelonBrowser.securityPolicy.markdownDescription: Controls which pages the embedded browser is allowed to load.

canelonBrowser.searchEngine.markdownDescription: URL template used when the text typed in the address bar is not a URL. `%s` is replaced by the URL-encoded query. Note that many search engines send `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN` and therefore cannot be displayed inside the webview.

canelonBrowser.homeUrl.markdownDescription: Page loaded when the panel opens and when the Home button is pressed.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
